dz: 葡萄牙波尔图的立宪派叛乱.
de: Constitutionalist insurrection at Oporto, Portugal.

t: 圣路易斯条约在密苏里州圣路易斯签订.
te: The Treaty of St. Louis is signed in St. Louis, Missouri.
dz: 圣路易斯条约在密苏里州圣路易斯签订.
de: The Treaty of St. Louis is signed in St. Louis, Missouri.

t: 荷兰现代宪法签署。
te: The modern Constitution of the Netherlands is signed.
dz: 荷兰现代宪法签署。
de: The modern Constitution of the Netherlands is signed.

t: 英国军队攻克了华盛顿特区,并点燃了总统府,都城,海军场和许多其他公共建筑.
te: British troops capture Washington, D.C. and set the Presidential Mansion, Capitol, Navy Yard and many other public buil…
dz: 英国军队攻克了华盛顿特区,并点燃了总统府,都城,海军场和许多其他公共建筑.
de: British troops capture Washington, D.C. and set the Presidential Mansion, Capitol, Navy Yard and many other public buildings ablaze.

t: 由西班牙,英国,葡萄牙等势力组成的联盟,成功解除了长达两年半的Cádiz围攻.
te: A coalition of Spanish, British, and Portuguese forces succeed in lifting the two-and-a-half-year-long Siege of Cádiz.
dz: 半岛战争:由西班牙,英国,葡萄牙等势力组成的联盟,成功解除了长达两年半的Cádiz围攻.
de: Peninsular War: A coalition of Spanish, British, and Portuguese forces succeed in lifting the two-and-a-half-year-long Siege of Cádiz.

t: 斯文斯克松德号的第一次海战从芬兰湾开始.
te: The first naval battle of the Svensksund begins in the Gulf of Finland.
dz: 斯文斯克松德号的第一次海战从芬兰湾开始.
de: The first naval battle of the Svensksund begins in the Gulf of Finland.

t: 一小股宾夕法尼亚民兵遭到美洲印第安人团体的伏击和压倒，迫使乔治·罗杰斯·克拉克放弃进攻底特律的…
te: A small force of Pennsylvania militia is ambushed and overwhelmed by an American Indian group, which forces George Roge…
dz: 美国独立战争：一小股宾夕法尼亚民兵遭到美洲印第安人团体的伏击和压倒，迫使乔治·罗杰斯·克拉克放弃进攻底特律的企图。
de: American Revolutionary War: A small force of Pennsylvania militia is ambushed and overwhelmed by an American Indian group, which forces George Rogers Clark to abandon his attempt to attack Detroit.

t: 瑞典军队向赫尔辛基的俄国人投降,结束了战争并开始了"小怒".
te: The Swedish army surrenders to the Russians in Helsinki, ending the war and starting Lesser Wrath.
dz: 帽子之战:瑞典军队向赫尔辛基的俄国人投降,结束了战争并开始了"小怒".
de: The War of the Hats: The Swedish army surrenders to the Russians in Helsinki, ending the war and starting Lesser Wrath.

t: 东印度公司的乔布·查诺克(Job Charnock)在加尔各答建立了一个工厂,这个活动以前被认…
te: Job Charnock of the East India Company establishes a factory in Calcutta, an event formerly considered the founding of …
dz: 东印度公司的乔布·查诺克(Job Charnock)在加尔各答建立了一个工厂,这个活动以前被认为是该市的创立(2003年加尔各答高等法院裁定该市的奠基日期不详).
de: Job Charnock of the East India Company establishes a factory in Calcutta, an event formerly considered the founding of the city (in 2003 the Calcutta High Court ruled that the city's foundation date is unknown).

t: 威廉·潘恩接收了现在的特拉华州所在的地区,并添加到他的殖民地宾夕法尼亚.
te: William Penn receives the area that is now the state of Delaware, and adds it to his colony of Pennsylvania.
dz: 威廉·潘恩接收了现在的特拉华州所在的地区,并添加到他的殖民地宾夕法尼亚.
de: William Penn receives the area that is now the state of Delaware, and adds it to his colony of Pennsylvania.

t: 约翰三世·索比耶斯基手下的波兰-立陶宛军队在卢瓦尔战役中击败了奥斯曼-塔塔尔军队.
te: A Polish-Lithuanian army under John III Sobieski defeats an Ottoman-Tartar army in the battle of Lwow.
dz: 约翰三世·索比耶斯基手下的波兰-立陶宛军队在卢瓦尔战役中击败了奥斯曼-塔塔尔军队.
de: A Polish-Lithuanian army under John III Sobieski defeats an Ottoman-Tartar army in the battle of Lwow.

t: 1662 年的《公祷书》作为英国国教会的礼拜仪式在法律上强制执行，导致持不同政见的牧师被逐出圣…
te: The 1662 Book of Common Prayer is legally enforced as the liturgy of the Church of England, precipitating the Great Eje…
dz: 1662 年的《公祷书》作为英国国教会的礼拜仪式在法律上强制执行，导致持不同政见的牧师被逐出圣职。
de: The 1662 Book of Common Prayer is legally enforced as the liturgy of the Church of England, precipitating the Great Ejection of Dissenter ministers from their benefices.

t: 一支荷兰分舰队在智利南部的瓦尔迪维亚废墟上建立了一个新的殖民地.
te: A Dutch fleet establishes a new colony in the ruins of Valdivia in southern Chile.
dz: 一支荷兰分舰队在智利南部的瓦尔迪维亚废墟上建立了一个新的殖民地.
de: A Dutch fleet establishes a new colony in the ruins of Valdivia in southern Chile.

t: 英国驻印度的首位官方代表登陆苏拉特.
te: The first official English representative to India lands in Surat.
dz: 英国驻印度的首位官方代表登陆苏拉特.
de: The first official English representative to India lands in Surat.

t: 奥兰治的威廉嫁给了萨克森的安娜公爵夫人.
te: Willem of Orange marries duchess Anna of Saxony.
dz: 奥兰治的威廉嫁给了萨克森的安娜公爵夫人.
de: Willem of Orange marries duchess Anna of Saxony.

t: 在塞利姆一世统治下的奥斯曼帝国击败了马姆卢克苏丹国,并在马季达比克战役中夺取了现在的叙利亚.
te: The Ottoman Empire under Selim I defeats the Mamluk Sultanate and captures present-day Syria at the Battle of Marj Dabi…
dz: 在塞利姆一世统治下的奥斯曼帝国击败了马姆卢克苏丹国,并在马季达比克战役中夺取了现在的叙利亚.
de: The Ottoman Empire under Selim I defeats the Mamluk Sultanate and captures present-day Syria at the Battle of Marj Dabiq.

t: Berwick-up-Tweed的城镇和城堡被一支英格兰军队从苏格兰夺取.
te: The town and castle of Berwick-upon-Tweed is captured from Scotland by an English army.
dz: Berwick-up-Tweed的城镇和城堡被一支英格兰军队从苏格兰夺取.
de: The town and castle of Berwick-upon-Tweed is captured from Scotland by an English army.

t: 六千名犹太人在美因茨被责怪为暴发性瘟疫后被杀死.
te: Six thousand Jews are killed in Mainz after being blamed for the bubonic plague.
dz: 六千名犹太人在美因茨被责怪为暴发性瘟疫后被杀死.
de: Six thousand Jews are killed in Mainz after being blamed for the bubonic plague.

t: 一支英国分舰队在桑威奇战役中击败了一支法国分舰队,切断了法兰西王子路易的补给,并削弱了他在一等…
te: An English fleet defeats a French fleet in the battle of Sandwich, cutting off Prince Louis of France from supplies and…
dz: 一支英国分舰队在桑威奇战役中击败了一支法国分舰队,切断了法兰西王子路易的补给,并削弱了他在一等男爵之战中获得英国王位的希望.
de: An English fleet defeats a French fleet in the battle of Sandwich, cutting off Prince Louis of France from supplies and diminishing his hopes to gain the English throne during the First Barons' War.

t: 教宗英诺森三世发布一头公牛宣布"大宪章"无效.
te: Pope Innocent III issues a bull declaring Magna Carta invalid.
dz: 教宗英诺森三世发布一头公牛宣布"大宪章"无效.
de: Pope Innocent III issues a bull declaring Magna Carta invalid.

t: 第一部"大宪章"的签署人英格兰国王约翰与安古莱姆大教堂的伊莎贝拉结婚.
te: King John of England, signer of the first Magna Carta, marries Isabella of Angoulême in Angoulême Cathedral.
dz: 第一部"大宪章"的签署人英格兰国王约翰与安古莱姆大教堂的伊莎贝拉结婚.
de: King John of England, signer of the first Magna Carta, marries Isabella of Angoulême in Angoulême Cathedral.

t: 由诺曼人出品的"Thessalonica".
te: Sack of Thessalonica by the Normans.
dz: 由诺曼人出品的"Thessalonica".
de: Sack of Thessalonica by the Normans.

t: 阿拉里克国王手下的维西哥斯人开始掠夺罗马.
te: The Visigoths under King Alaric I begin to pillage Rome.
dz: 阿拉里克国王手下的维西哥斯人开始掠夺罗马.
de: The Visigoths under King Alaric I begin to pillage Rome.

t: 埃斯梅特-阿克霍姆的格拉菲托是埃及象形文字中最新的已知铭文.
te: The Graffito of Esmet-Akhom, the latest known inscription in Egyptian hieroglyphs, is written.
dz: 埃斯梅特-阿克霍姆的格拉菲托是埃及象形文字中最新的已知铭文.
de: The Graffito of Esmet-Akhom, the latest known inscription in Egyptian hieroglyphs, is written.

t: 罗马皇帝瓦伦蒂安一世之子格拉提安被父亲以同名奥古斯都八岁取名.
te: Gratian, son of Roman Emperor Valentinian I, is named co-Augustus at the age of eight by his father.
dz: 罗马皇帝瓦伦蒂安一世之子格拉提安被父亲以同名奥古斯都八岁取名.
de: Gratian, son of Roman Emperor Valentinian I, is named co-Augustus at the age of eight by his father.
